title: Sub-agents and their Bash allowlist
summary: An orchestrator/specialists split: implementer, verifier, doc-sync and reviewer agents on lighter models, with a tested hook that confines the read-only ones to exact command shapes.
postInstall: List the project's verification commands (tests, build, type-check) in .claude/hooks/agent-bash-guard.config.json: the verifier agent can run nothing else.
Requires node >= 20 on the machine: the hook fails closed without it (every Bash command of a guarded agent is blocked).

The hook only runs in a folder whose workspace trust prompt was accepted — each clone and each git worktree separately, and never in a headless session started in an untrusted folder. Until then the read-only agents run unguarded: docs/conventions/agent-bash-guard.md § Trust.
Check the hook live once per folder, and again after each Claude Code upgrade: docs/conventions/agent-bash-guard.md § Live check. The tests prove the script, not the runtime calling it.
Restart open Claude Code sessions: a running session does not pick up new agent files reliably.
